assumptions.statement_zh: 官方边界与重点区多边形尚未发布;本包所有几何为 provisional 临时数据,官方数据发布后必须按同一公式重算并更新图件。
assumptions.statement_en: No official boundary or key-area polygons are published yet; all geometry here is provisional and must be recomputed when official data arrives.

assumptions.statement_zh: 轨道保护区、站城一体化控制条件、控规指标、文保与生态管控边界、市政容量及地下空间条件未知;本方案不臆造任何此类结论。
assumptions.statement_en: Statutory controls (railway protection zone, FAR, height, heritage/ecology boundaries, municipal capacity) are unknown; this proposal fabricates no conclusions about them.

assumptions.statement_zh: 现状基线缺失(校园开放界面、慢行断点、公共空间品质、无障碍连续性、存量建筑状态、设施供需与客流时段);用地比例与留改拆比例均为情景假设。
assumptions.statement_en: Baseline data (campus interfaces, slow-traffic gaps, public-space quality, accessibility continuity, building stock, facility supply-demand, ridership) is missing; all land and retain-renovate-demolish ratios are scenario assumptions.

assumptions.statement_zh: 所有设施与节点均为概念可逆设计建议,非建设承诺;品牌名称未完成商标检索,仅作内部工作代号。
assumptions.statement_en: All facilities and nodes are original reversible conceptual proposals, not construction commitments; brand names are internal working codenames pending trademark clearance.

assumptions.statement_zh: 交通与人流量数据仅以匿名聚合方式参照,不识别个体;涉人决策人工复核;无障碍服务保留人工兜底与一键关闭。
assumptions.statement_en: Mobility and crowd data are referenced as anonymous aggregates only; no individuals are identified; people-affecting decisions get human review; accessible services keep human fallback and one-touch shutdown.

assumptions.statement_zh: 活动体系与分期节奏为设计建议,非政府或运营方承诺;成本均为量级与基期口径,非精确投资金额。
assumptions.statement_en: The event system and phasing are design suggestions, not confirmed government or operator commitments; costs are tiers with base-period scope, not precise investment amounts.
